capabilities.label: See channels
capabilities.description: See the community's public channels and be in them. Channel and category permissions can take it away.

capabilities.label: Post in channels
capabilities.description: Send messages in the community's channels.

capabilities.label: Share files
capabilities.description: Send photos, videos, voice messages and files in channels.

capabilities.label: Post announcements
capabilities.description: Post in announcement channels, where only managers can post.

capabilities.label: Manage channels
capabilities.description: Rename, reorder, move, archive and manage the members and permissions of channels and categories.

capabilities.label: Create channels and categories
capabilities.description: Create channels, voice channels, forums and categories.

capabilities.label: Join voice channels
capabilities.description: Join the calls in voice channels.

capabilities.label: Speak in voice channels
capabilities.description: Talk, share video and share the screen in voice channels. Without it, people listen only.
